snippet.title: Snowbound Launch Trailer | Halo Infinite
snippet.description:
The holidays are here, and so is Operation: Snowbound! Running from today until January 7, this festive event brings loads of seasonal cheer and exciting updates to Halo Infinite. Enjoy the 1v1 Showdown, Snowball Fight mode (coming soon), a free 20-tier pass, festive fits, and more.  

Read more here: https://www.aka.ms/SnowboundLaunch

Happy Halodays, Spartans! 

#halo #haloinfinite #operationsnowbound
